{{Quote|The sky was full of them as they descended upon us. I wondered if our men on the ground would think us brave fools, or just fools.|Eyewitness report of Lieutenant Blair|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Blair''' fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with a [[Unidentified resistance group|resistance group]]<ref name="TIE" /> before or during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''The Force Unleashed II'' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the databank have to happen before or in 1 BBY.</ref> Blair was the only survivor out of the resistance fighters who fought in the air at the [[Battle of Slotern]]. Blair and other resistance fighters were fighting in ancient [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] against the Empire, when [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] attacked their older [[Starship/Legends|craft]]. Only Blair and the Lieutenant's [[Unidentified wingman|wingman]] were left after the initial attack by the TIEs. The assault was so sudden and shocking that Blair was unable to fire any weapons. The TIEs came back and shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Blair's [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], while badly damaging Blair's craft. Blair dove for the ground, and the automatic [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejection]] activated on Blair's craft. Blair was the only survivor of the two-[[Standard minute/Legends|minute]]-long battle. The pilot later had an Eyewitness Report about the battle.<ref name="TIE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blair was mentioned in the "TIE fighter" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="TIE" />
